label: Illustrative labor-capacity model; not measured savings or an industry average

sources.fact: May 2025 U.S. software-developer median wage: $135,980 per year. Checked October 26, 2026.
June 2026 private-industry wages were 70.0% of total employer compensation; this is a broad workforce ratio, not a developer-specific estimate.
Compare automation's implementation and maintenance effort with the repetitive work it removes.

scope: One year; 14/18 demo runtime mix rounded down for larger fleets; the first directly configured pilot is common to both paths and excluded. Qualifying investigations count only cases where OBI supplies useful visibility the baseline lacks. Existing equally useful traces imply zero triage credit. Direct/upstream templates and namespace opt-in belong in the baseline. All workflow hours, frequencies and domain counts are authored assumptions. Values are capacity after platform labor, before additional telemetry, support and prototype-hardening costs. No waiting-time, outage-revenue or cash-reduction claim.
